QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member` and "The default protects the library's API boundary, meaning application developers who include the public headers. The opt-out is for code that is part of the library or the test tooling."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS gives plain member names while the default for ordinary public-header consumers renames them to private_*.
